thread:
Ravi Singh: Uh — flagged by Kepler support: they were invoiced ~7,900 extra embeds on 2026-07-12 (10:00-10:30 UTC). Customer Talos claims those were theirs. Looks like a cross-tenant attribution issue. Can infra triage?

BillingBot: [alert] proxy-headers-drop ap-northeast-1 2026-07-12T10:12:07Z -> missing x-tenant-id observed in 0.6% of requests. Event id: PH-20260712-1012.

Marta Lopez: I pulled the canonical rows and ledger. Quick query:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as rows
FROM embeds_canonical
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-07-12T10:00:00Z' AND '2026-07-12T10:30:00Z'
AND model='rwl-1'
GROUP BY customer_id;
-- results: talos => 42,312; kepler => 2,104
```
Ledger shows talos billed 49,998, kepler billed 10,004. That suggests ~7,900 rows were attributed to talos but belong to kepler.

Chen Wu: Correlating request logs: during the failover the proxy dropped x-tenant-id on ~7,908 requests. Those requests were processed and embedded but defaulted to the proxied tenant (talos) because fallback tenant header config points to tenant with highest recent throughput.

Sana Ibrahim: This is bad — cross-customer misattribution. Remediation options: (A) transfer usage back from Talos to Kepler (ledger-level move), (B) issue credits to Kepler and leave ledger as-is, or (C) rewrite ledger by replaying ack events with corrected tenant ids. Which is lowest audit-risk?

Alex Romero: Rewriting ledger via replay of corrected ack events is preferred if we can produce an end-to-end manifest. Steps: (1) reconstruct original requests with x-original-tenant from proxy debug logs, (2) replay ack events into billing-acks with corrected tenant_id, (3) run recount. Risk: must ensure idempotency and that Talos isn't charged twice. Time estimate: 3-4 hours.

Ravi Singh: Finance/Legal preference? Transfers (A) look risky for audits; rewrite (C) is tidy but requires a clear manifest.

Marta Lopez: I can produce a per-request mapping file for the window showing original_request_id, observed_tenant, reconstructed_tenant, embed_id. Link to S3 once generated. It will include checksums and counts.

BillingBot: [info] ticket FIN-9007 created: "Cross-tenant attribution - ap-northeast proxy header drop -> Kepler/Talos" assigned to @Chen Wu.

Chen Wu: Starting reconstruction job now (job_id=recon-ph-20260712). Will attach mapping.csv to s3://redwood-telemetry/recon/recon-ph-20260712/mapping.csv when done.

Sana Ibrahim: Finance note: provisional delta for Kepler = 7,908 * $0.115/embed = $909.42. We'll hold any billing changes until replay/mapping artifact is produced.

Chen Wu: Reconstruction complete at 2026-07-12T13:05:12Z. mapping.csv uploaded. SHA256: e9b1c3a7d4f5e6b8c9a0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2. S3: s3://redwood-telemetry/recon/recon-ph-20260712/mapping.csv

Marta Lopez: Ran a dry-run replay (no publish) that shows corrected ledger would decrement Talos by 7,908 and increment Kepler by 7,908. We'll need to open a controlled replay that writes to billing-acks with corrected tenant_id and ensure downstream dedupe keys set to avoid duplicates.

Alex Romero: Executing live replay now (replay-id=rp-apn-ph-20260712-correct). Will flip tenant-dedupe-mode for the window and run. Expect ~2 hours to complete + validation.

BillingBot: [info] FIN-9007 status updated -> replay in progress.

Alex Romero: Replay finished at 2026-07-12T15:40:55Z. Written 7,908 corrected ack events. Manifest: s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-apn-ph-20260712-correct/manifest.json SHA256: 5f2d7b9a3c4e6d8f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3

Marta Lopez: Post-replay recount: Talos ledger decreased by 7,908, Kepler increased by 7,908, canonical totals unchanged. Uploaded recount csv: s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-07-12/kepler-talos-attribution-fix.csv

Sana Ibrahim: Finance: confirmed adjustment -> transfer usage on ledger (Talos -7908, Kepler +7908). We will not issue separate credits. Adjusted invoice delta for Kepler: +$909.42; Talos will receive a corresponding invoice correction/credit of -$909.42. We'll attach mapping and replay manifests to both invoices.

Ravi Singh: Customer communication: Kepler and Talos will get separate messages explaining we fixed an attribution bug and attached the manifest. Legal approved language to keep it non-technical. Drafting now for #customer-communication.

BillingBot: [info] FIN-9007 -> awaiting customer ACKs.

Marta Lopez: All artifacts uploaded and checksums verified. Closing this thread after customers confirm. :white_check_mark:
